coverage_notes: This branch records the actual official style-program dimensions, including the inherited standard LaTeX 11pt-size definitions. The class label 11pt selects a native normal font size of 10.95 TeX pt.

The prose guide calls the title 15pt and margins 25mm; the actual 2021v1 package selects a 14.4 TeX pt title and computes unequal physical margins from TeX offsets. Both sets remain distinct in the detailed JSON.

The title and author block span both columns in the source. General paragraph formatting does not reproduce the fixed full-width title box, review line rulers, confidentiality header or exact page composition.
Caption alignment is conditional: short captions center and long captions justify. No unconditional caption alignment is imposed.
Levels four and five are run-in headings. Their text-span styling and horizontal after-space are metadata; this profile does not treat them as separate displayed paragraphs.

Anonymous submission removes identifying author details in the original style. This formatter preserves source content and cannot perform anonymization; the submission input must already have the correct author placeholder.
Reference text, citation content and numbering remain unchanged. TeX elastic glue is recorded as natural values and stretch/shrink metadata, not falsely equated with rigid page spacing.

Word applies the recorded paragraph indents. Generic LaTeX reports heading/caption/list/table indentation as UNVERIFIED because label-aware structural composition is not implemented; successful PDF compilation does not upgrade those checks.

coverage_notes: This branch records the actual official style-program dimensions, including the inherited standard LaTeX 11pt-size definitions. The class label 11pt selects a native normal font size of 10.95 TeX pt.

The prose guide calls the title 15pt and margins 25mm; the actual 2021v1 package selects a 14.4 TeX pt title and computes unequal physical margins from TeX offsets. Both sets remain distinct in the detailed JSON.

The title and author block span both columns in the source. General paragraph formatting does not reproduce the fixed full-width title box, review line rulers, confidentiality header or exact page composition.
Caption alignment is conditional: short captions center and long captions justify. No unconditional caption alignment is imposed.
Levels four and five are run-in headings. Their text-span styling and horizontal after-space are metadata; this profile does not treat them as separate displayed paragraphs.

Anonymous submission removes identifying author details in the original style. This formatter preserves source content and cannot perform anonymization; the submission input must already have the correct author placeholder.
Reference text, citation content and numbering remain unchanged. TeX elastic glue is recorded as natural values and stretch/shrink metadata, not falsely equated with rigid page spacing.

Word applies the recorded paragraph indents. Generic LaTeX reports heading/caption/list/table indentation as UNVERIFIED because label-aware structural composition is not implemented; successful PDF compilation does not upgrade those checks.

coverage_notes: Default author branch only. The manyauthors branch has different two-column author composition and is not silently substituted.
The source includes the header area in its top28mm geometry margin. Physical text starts at28mm+12TeXpt headheight+25TeXpt headsep; the executable top text margin records that computed value.
Native 11pt-class normalsize is10.95TeXpt, not an integer11. Typography is measured from the actual class with its Times default.

Author and affiliation rows use distinct fonts and sizes; tabular struts and arraystretch1.2 determine row spacing. The full title-block blank-line/page metadata composition remains outside generic paragraph formatting.
Short captions center; long captions justify. Variable bibliography-label widths depend on the maximum label, so the profile does not impose the measured single-digit example as a universal indent.

Run-in headings, running header content, inline bold abstract/keyword labels, footnote symbols, math fonts, reference text and pagination require composition/content review. Natural skips retain their source elasticity metadata.

Word applies the recorded paragraph indents. Generic LaTeX reports heading/caption/list/table indentation as UNVERIFIED because label-aware structural composition is not implemented; successful PDF compilation does not upgrade those checks.
